reason: The text explicitly portrays the Israelites as a nation (עַם - am) and references their specific inherited land multiple times. Most directly, the passage states 'תְּבִאֵ֗מוֹ וְתִטָּעֵ֙מוֹ֙ בְּהַ֣ר נַחֲלָֽתְךָ' ('Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance'), and 'נָחִ֥יתָ בְחַסְדְּךָ֖ עַם־ ז֣וּ גָּאָ֑לְתָּ אֶל־ נְוֵ֥ה קָדְשֶֽׁךָ' ('Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed unto thy holy habitation'). These passages clearly establish that God is leading the nation of Israel to a specific, promised land designated as their inheritance and dwelling place.
